correctness.rationale: The incidence rows are 1 minus a product of coordinate nonmatch indicators. Multiplicative characters of the finite abelian unit group diagonalize the incidence Gram matrix. Explicit rowwise character sums for trivial and nontrivial types produce all stated eigenvalues; the only zero Gram character type is the full support, of multiplicity \(\prod_i(q_i-2)\). The bipartite block matrix supplies the paired square-root spectrum and full nullity. The boundary r=1 is excluded. Thirteen exact integer Gram-characteristic-polynomial checks, including prime-field direct-addition comparisons, support this reconstructed proof without substituting finite tests for it.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete, all-parameter spectral answer to an explicit natural question on finite reduced commutative rings. It handles arbitrary field-factor cardinalities, with a closed spectral factorization, multiplicities, incidence rank \(\prod_i(q_i-1)-\prod_i(q_i-2)\), and graph nullity. The full-factor classification is not the textbook two-factor subdivision special case; the result supplies substantive structure and an independently useful invariant.
